name: Later violations: disconnection and blacklisting for one year (r. 25(6)(b))

attrs.quote: shall be disconnected by all the Access Providers for one year
attrs.scope: Senders or Telemarketers found to have sent UCC again
attrs.note: The Sender is blacklisted, no Access Provider gives it new resources, and the devices used are blocked for the year. One number with outgoing services barred may be kept.
